question: Which model was the First Five Year Plan based on?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harrod-Domar.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Harrod____-Domar__

 __
 
• The Harrod–Domar model is a Keynesian model of economic growth.
 
• It is used in development economics to explain an economy's growth rate in terms of the level of saving and of capital.
 
• It suggests that there is no natural reason for an economy to have balanced growth.
 
• The model was developed independently by** Roy F. Harrod in 1939**, and **Evsey Domar in 1946.**
 
• The Harrod–Domar model was the precursor to the exogenous growth model.
 
• It was the** first five-year** **plan** based on the model.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gadgil Yojana**

 
 
• **​​**Gadgil Yojana was implemented for the distribution of plan transfer amongst the states.
 
• Its aim was the development of agriculture as well as to enhance the production of wheat.
 
• Gadgil yojana's purpose was to solve the problem of the economic crisis.
 
• Gadgil's Yojana was India's** third five-year plan**
 
 
 
• **PC Mahalanobis Model**
 
 
• **​**Mahalanobis Plan was India’s **second five-year plan.**
 
• It was proposed by **Professor Prasanta Chandra Mahalanobis.**
 
• This plan gave priority to investment goods, as they were crucial for the further economic growth of India.
 
• The plan explores the allocation of investment between the different sectors of the economy.
 
 

e5:T
